sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:25

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:25:1
items.html: AA returned a second time to couple within himself, in the discernment of his internality, and did not clothe within AVI: As above — for now he needs to receive from the statures of HGT of Nekudim, which the HGT of Atik took; but since this is the second Ibur, of the Mochin, he needs to receive these HGT from the discernment of what they become when they return to be HBD — namely, from the clothing of the seven lower [Sefirot] of Atik within the Reisha [head] of AA, where they become HBD, as is known. Therefore they now have no reason at all to clothe within AVI of Atzilut.
